title.narrative: Support strategic dialogue "Future Resilience from mountain to coast" (for Northern Java)

description.narrative: This assignment envisages a joint dialogue that results in a (first outline of) strategic programmatic approach under the Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) Water, to move within the bilateral cooperation towards a Resilience Integrated Water Management. The strategic dialogue aims to inform the outline of the multi-year programme for a strategic programmatic approach and with that identify and further concretise the areas of mutual interest of Government of Indonesia (GoI) and the Government of the Netherlands (GoN), among which Nature-based Solutions, Urban water resilience, Water Governance and Participation.More concrete, the (outline) for the multiyear includes:• A shared ambition/goal to be achieved within the bilateral partnership by the end of the multi-year programme (2024-2027) to be mutually agreed upon by GoI and GoN.• Outline the major components/fields of cooperation within this multi-year programme• Detail the initial steps for cooperation within this multi-year programme by compiling a workplan towards the next Joint Steering Committee (JSC) in 1.5 years.ApproachThe joint core team (consisting of representatives from both GoI and GoN) plays an active and central role in the guidance of the strategic dialogue. The outline of the multi-year programme is the envisioned result of a combined process of one-on-one conversations between the core team and relevant stakeholders and of a multistakeholder dialogue.The strategic dialogue forms the basis for the Joint Working Group Session during the JSC. Given the limited time prior to the JSC, the exact deliverables to be achieved prior to the JSC needs to be set in mutual consent with GoN and GoI. From the JSC onwards, the strategic dialogue is continued for two more months to further substantiate the vision and integrate the outcomes of the Joint Working Group Session during the JSC.The joint core team is asked to agree upon a roadmap with a realistic and detailed planning of activities to guide the strategic dialogue towards the JSC and beyond.
